Bengal BJP MLA Rekha Patra Hospitalized Amid Poisoning Speculation

Rekha Patra, a BJP MLA and a figure associated with the Sandeshkhali protests, was admitted to the hospital and later taken off a ventilator as her health improved. Initial medical reports suggested pesticide poisoning, while the BJP attributed her condition to food poisoning. A medical team including a nephrologist and a toxicology specialist examined her.
